note: An escape decoding to NUL inside a string body; the list wrapper is only so both sides print the string with its quotes, as reader-string-hex does. Both sides now READ it to the same two bytes -- Phase 25 gave fe strings a length, so a stored NUL is a byte like any other -- and they disagree only in the printed form: Emacs emits the raw NUL between the quotes and fe escapes it as \000, because a FeReadFn answers one char and spells end of input as 0, so a raw NUL is where fe's reader would stop.
